finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report: **Objective 1 — DONE.** Published posts whose titles start with `Seed:` (exactly as shown, from the Published filter in the Posts list): - `Seed: Welcome to the bench` - `Seed: Release notes for September` - `Seed: House style guide` (No `Seed:` posts exist as drafts or scheduled; the seed posts were not modified.) **Objective 2 — DONE.** Post `fwgh13-n1 Bench Post` exists, with exactly one paragraph in the body containing the runid: "This bench post was created by run fwgh13-n1 for verification." (verified as a single `

` element, appearing once, not duplicated). **Objective 3 — DONE.** Its only tag is the existing `Bench News`, selected from the tag field's suggestion dropdown (not the similar `Bench Newsletter`, and no new tag was created). **Objective 4 — DONE.** Custom excerpt: "Bench verification post for run fwgh13-n1." — includes the runid. **Objective 5 — DONE.** Status is Published (editor header shows "Published" with an Unpublish button, no Publish button; it appears in the Published posts list alongside the 3 seed posts). Visibility is Public (access combobox value `public`). The public page loads at http://127.0.0.1:8099/fwgh13-n1-bench-post/ showing the title and body. Note: the app's clock reads 24 Sep 2026, so the 2026-09-01 date is in the past and Ghost's confirmation flow offered "Publish post, right now" rather than scheduling — the post was published, not scheduled. **Objective 6 — DONE.** Publish date shown in the post's settings: 2026-09-01 (time 12:27 UTC). **Objective 7 — DONE.** URL slug as shown in the post's settings panel: `fwgh13-n1-bench-post` (full URL shown as 127.0.0.1:8099/fwgh13-n1-bench-post/).
